text:
```yaml
name: PR CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Upgrade dependencies
        run: npm update

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint --if-present

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build --if-present

      - name: Test
        run: npm test --if-present
```
